type DB struct{}

// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.

package appwire

import (
	"context"

	"app/shared"
)

func NewSync(ctx context.Context) (*shared.Report, error) {
	sharedDB, err := shared.NewDB()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sharedReport, err := shared.NewReport(sharedDB)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return sharedReport, nil
}
